label: Cabover Box Truck
generated: measured off the rig source by hand-transcription with per-value provenance; no generator in the rig

frame.origin: ground-centre of the body footprint (bumpers excluded from the centring; z=0 is the road)
frame.at_rest: every value here is at susF=susR=0, doors and roll-up shut, cab down, liftgate stowed. See LIFTGATE and TILT for what moves.

pivot_px._note: model z=0 projects to the pivot row in all 8 facings

VARIANTS._what: NONE. This class has no build variants — no roof heights, no glass options. The one body covers the class.

liftgate._note: a PART toggle, not a variant: false removes the tuck-under mechanism entirely and nothing else changes — same bumperettes, same ICC bar, same published z table. Decide it at spawn all the same.

collider_bbox._note: the black front arch flares are the widest hard point (2.14 m); the box is 2.12. Mirrors reach 2.60 over — add 0.23 m per side above z 1.68 if they must be solid.

ground_clearance_m.source: rear diff tube r 0.145 centred z 0.334 (buildWheels)
ground_clearance_m._note: mudflaps are rubber — sweep them, do not collide them. The stowed liftgate is STEEL at 0.34 m: it does collide.

BODY.provenance: BODIES.caboverBox + G; mirrors from buildCab boxes |1.20..1.30|

CAB._what: a low-cab-forward crew compartment ON TOP of the engine: high flat floor, three-across seating, and the whole room TILTS (see TILT).

floor.provenance: buildCab floor slab at G.cabFloorZ; headliner z 2.22

obstructions._note: the engine tunnel between the seats — the cross-cab route goes over it

floor.provenance: buildBox floor slab at G.boxFloorZ — exact

door_entry._note: the opening head (2.84) is 0.12 under the ceiling — tall cargo clears the bay but not the door

obstructions._note: the open door lies flat under the ceiling over the aft 1.9 m of bay — nothing taller than 1.92 m stands there while the door is up

CARGO.flat: NO wheel tubs, no step, no hump — the 0.92 m floor rides ABOVE the duals, flat wall to wall. That is the class's whole argument.

motion.rule: 12 slats climb a vertical track 1.88 m in the rear plane, bend forward and stack flat at z 2.88 under the ceiling

keep_clear._note: NONE. Zero swept volume behind the truck — the door never leaves the body, and the painted bbox at N is identical closed and open (the harness asserts it). Loading clearance behind the tail is the LIFTGATE's, not the door's.

boarding._note: sill = cargo floor. Bare, it is a climb; the liftgate at gate=1 is the step

reach_point._note: NOT tested against ground colliders, and it stands ON the liftgate keep-clear — see _confirm.reach_vs_gate

keep_clear._note: sweep of the free edge about the hinge axis; the collider is the arc, not the leaf. RIDES THE TILT — a tilted cab carries its door arcs with it.

boarding._note: two steps then the high floor — see STEP

reach_point._note: outside the swept disc; NOT tested against ground colliders

mirror.rides: the CAB (A-pillar arms), not this door

LIFTGATE._what: a tuck-under liftgate on the tail: one 0..1 param, three phases, and the only thing on this truck that wants clearance behind it.

swing.what: the folded platform swings out from under the tail to dock height, level with the cargo floor

unfold.what: the flip half rotates 180deg aft — full 1.20 m platform at dock height, flush with the sill

lower.what: parallel arms lower the level platform to the ground

stowed._note: folded double under the tail, inside the LOA — nothing pokes past the bumperettes

deployed._note: the platform plan while gate > 0.45; during the swing (0..0.45) the same rectangle is swept at and below dock height

loading_zone._note: a working margin for the hand truck and the loader — a REQUEST, not geometry

STEP._note: two fixed treads per side under the doors' aft half — 0.30, 0.58, then the 0.85 m floor. They are CAB parts and ride the tilt. The liftgate at gate=1 is the only step into the BOX.

TOW._note: NOTHING. No ball, no pintle, no fifth wheel, no front recovery points. The ICC underride bar (y -3.20..-3.14, z 0.40..0.48) is a safety bar, not a coupling — do not let a game hang a trailer on it.

SUSPENSION.applies_to: the whole body group (frame, cab, box, roll-up, liftgate in any phase) — the wheels do NOT move
SUSPENSION.consequence: every polygon in CAB, CARGO, THRESHOLD and LIFTGATE rides that dz; t extrapolates past both axles so the bumpers pitch further than the travel.

WHEELS._note: roll is per-CORNER (wFL wFR wRL wRR, REVOLUTIONS) — each dual pair shares its corner's roll. One revolution (2.099 m) closes the bake bit-identical: 21.007 tread stripes of 0.0999 m plus 6-fold lugs.
WHEELS.provenance: G.frontWX / dualXi / dualXo / axF / axR / wheelR / tireW — exact

STEERING.sense: +1 = full LEFT lock; the nose swings toward -x
STEERING.ackermann: outer = atan(1/(1/tan(inner) + track/wheelbase)), front track 1.56 m, wheelbase 4.12 m
STEERING.axis: vertical, through each front wheel centre — no kingpin offset, caster or scrub radius is modelled

turning_radius_m._note: geometric, at full lock. Tighter than the van (8.89) and the dually despite the longer wheelbase — the cabover's whole case in one number.

swept_envelope._note: at full lock a front tire corner stands 0.082 m proud of the cab side but 8 mm INSIDE the black arch flares — the flares are the collider width and the lock stops at 33deg to keep it that way.

STEERING.does_not: yaw the truck. STEERING turns the wheels; YAW turns the machine. A turning truck wants both.

TILT.rides: cab shell, glass, doors (and their arcs), mirrors, steps, seats, dash — the one group
TILT.stays: front bumper, frame, engine, box, roll-up, liftgate, wheels

latch._note: the cab locks down here — a repair interaction has a handle to pull

TILT.extreme: at tilt=1 the roof leading edge reaches y 4.26, z 1.96 — 0.84 m past the bumper. Do not tilt against a wall.
TILT._note: this class has NO hood — tilt IS the engine access, and the rig will happily tilt with people in the seats. Nothing stops it; see _confirm.
TILT.provenance: buildCab part() + rotX about G.tiltHinge; G.tiltDeg = 38

YAW.what: heading between the eight facings. The model turns about z before projection under a FIXED key, so the shading is rebaked for the new heading — this is not a rotated sprite.
YAW.pivot: unaffected; the origin projects to the published pivot at any yaw
YAW.frame: yaw is a RENDER param, not geometry. Every metre in this file is in the machine frame and does not move with it.
YAW.gameplay: a heading is dir*45 + yaw. Colliders, reach points and seat refs rotate with the machine as they always did; nothing here needs a yaw correction.

exhaust_tip._note: street side, aft — smoke/heat FX attach

fuel_tank._note: the tank is modelled; the filler neck is not (see _excluded)

box_roof._note: translucent-white panel — sign/rack attach; no rack is modelled and no route up exists

dock_sill._note: the alignment point for backing to a dock or a quay edge

INTERACT._note: the control pendant hangs at the curb-side tail corner

_interact_notes.reach_point: a request, not a promise — a ground-level standing spot derived from which face the item is on. NOT validated against terrain, kerb or another vehicle.
_interact_notes.visible_facings: the near-side test paint() uses: a feature with outward normal n is listed for facing d when nx*sin(d*45) + ny*cos(d*45) < -0.3, edge-on excluded. Top faces are visible at all eight.

_excluded.CLEATS: not a hull, and nothing on this truck couples to anything — see TOW.
_excluded.walkable_roof: a 1.80 x 4.20 m translucent panel at z 3.04 with no rack, no rail and no route up. Omitted rather than published as a surface.
_excluded.fuel_fill: no filler neck, cap or door is modelled anywhere on the body. The tank is in ATTACH.fuel_tank.
_excluded.plate_and_wipers: no licence plate, wipers, aerial or decals. At 32 px/m they are 1-3 px and were left out of the bake.
_excluded.spare_wheel: no spare is modelled, slung or otherwise.
_excluded.dock_bumpers: no rubber dock blocks on the tail — the bumperettes are steel and the sill plate is bare galv.
_excluded.cab_marker_lamps: the box carries its five ambers (three front header, two rear corners); the cab roof carries none.
_excluded.interior_INTERACT: nothing inside is an interactable — no glovebox, radio or handbrake in the rig.

_confirm.cargo_walkable: CARGO.floor is a 2.00 x 4.50 m rubber sole 0.92 m up under 2.04 m of headroom. Whether a player walks it (vs. it being a container) is unruled. It is published as geometry either way.
_confirm.gate_load: the platform is drawn, not rated. Pallet-vs-person capacity, overload behaviour and whether it lifts a vehicle are gameplay's call.
_confirm.gate_phase_stops: gate is one continuous 0..1. A game that wants 'dock work' should HOLD 0.70 (unfolded, level with the floor) — nothing in the rig detents there.
_confirm.reach_vs_gate: the rollup reach point [0,-3.70,0] stands inside the liftgate's deployed rectangle. With the gate down it is ON the platform; with the gate stowed it is clear road. Sequence the two or move the loader.
_confirm.rollup_headroom: the open door caps the aft 1.9 m of bay at 1.92 m of headroom (CARGO.obstructions.rollup_stack). Close the door before standing a tall crate at the tail.
_confirm.dock_height: the sill is 0.92 m. Harbour quay and warehouse dock heights are the WORLD's numbers — the truck publishes its own and takes no position on the gap.
_confirm.tilt_discipline: nothing couples tilt to doors, gate, occupancy or motion. A game that tilts a loaded, running truck gets exactly that. The rig will not stop it.
_confirm.mirror_collider: BODY.collider_bbox stops at the flares (2.14 m). The mirrors reach 2.60 m over — decide before a mirror clips a doorframe.
_confirm.steering_and_yaw: STEERING moves the wheels only; YAW moves the machine. Nothing couples them — a game that turns the wheels without yawing (or the reverse) will look wrong, and the rig will not stop it.
